properties.name: detect_backend_change
properties.description: Detects if the incoming MR diff is backend-touching. Checks both file path patterns and scans added lines (starting with "+") for MongoDB operation keywords. Resolves a confidence score: - "HIGH" -> matches migrations/ folder or endings: .model.py, models.py, .schema.py, .schema.js, .schema.ts - "MEDIUM" -> matches db/, database/, db_config.py/database.py keywords OR keyword matching in diff body - "LOW" -> config.py keyword match with exactly one occurrence Args: diff_text: Raw unified diff string. Returns: Tuple[is_backend_change, triggered_by_files, triggered_by_content, confidence]
